rows.text: You're amazing, boss! You saw right through my disguise again!
rows.speaker: Stubborn Furbo

rows.text: You weren't exactly hiding it well.
Oh, you mean the name card?
rows.speaker: Stubborn Furbo

rows.text: Hehe, I left that clue for you on purpose, boss! This game would be a total drag otherwise.
rows.speaker: Stubborn Furbo

rows.text: Don't even get me started! I'm beat.
Poor Boss! Let me give you a shoulder rub or something...
rows.speaker: Stubborn Furbo

rows.text: Oh, wait. I'm too short to reach your shoulders.
rows.speaker: Stubborn Furbo

rows.text: Wow, you really don't give up, do you?
Ahem... Anyway, while other furbos just transform for fun, I, Stubborn Furbo, am the only one who takes this undercover gig seriously!
rows.speaker: Stubborn Furbo

rows.text: I'll start using even more exclamation marks when I talk! Consider yourself warned!
rows.speaker: Stubborn Furbo
